changes: Added an InitialHarbor PlayMode route check for the active D19 terrain, DockGround and GangplankGround colliders.
Each route is raycast from its actual bounds, repositioned through the existing D2 owner, then exercised with real bidirectional ApplyPhysicsMotion steps.
The test waits for CharacterController contact after SetWorldPosition and checks both Unity and D2 grounded state; it does not disable collision or inject a passing state.

validation_attempts.reason: The first invocation exposed a missing test helper during compilation; no gameplay assertion was accepted.
The test read D2's stale grounded flag immediately after SetWorldPosition; timing was corrected to wait for actual CharacterController contact rather than weakening the assertion.

remaining_scope: The full visual-quality gate still requires three representative shore/ramp points, ten complete traversals and continuous visual evidence; this card records the smaller automated route contract only.
This does not prove native Player WASD input, visual mesh contact, ship boarding, ship-deck control or safe disembark; those remain Q09-Q14 and Q31 boundaries.
Q03 remains BLOCKED_ASSET, so Q08 cannot claim the full action integration gate.
status_boundary: Q07 VERIFIED means the active terrain/dock/gangplank collider contract and the tested bidirectional steps are evidenced. It is not a claim that every shore, slope, visual mesh or Player route is complete.
